Alex Chen: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — can owners confirm they accept the action items below and post realistic due dates? I'll consolidate and ping PMs.

Alex Chen: Actions I have: 1) Tune DB connection backoff + retries (suggested: Julian Ortiz) 2) Add canary path for schema rollbacks (suggested: Maya Patel) 3) Update runbook + alert thresholds (suggested: Emily Ryu) 4) QA plan for canary test matrix (suggested: Patrick Li)

Julian Ortiz: I'll take #1. realistic ETA is Wed 2026-04-13 EOD — need a small infra window to validate. Blocker: quota request pending for extra test nodes.

Maya Patel: I'll own #2 but need Patrick for QA and a short blackout window. Propose Tue 2026-04-12 for initial canary, final by Thu 2026-04-14.

Patrick Li: Happy to do QA for the canary. My schedule: available Mon/Tue mornings. Can we lock a 2hr window?

Emily Ryu: I'll update the runbook and threshold docs. Target Fri 2026-04-15. Will add a short troubleshooting checklist for the connection/backoff symptoms.

Alex Chen: Thanks — can each of you confirm in-thread with final ETA and any blockers you need me to escalate? I'll raise infra ticket for the quota if Julian confirms specifics. :thumbsup:

Julian Ortiz: Confirmed: Wed 2026-04-13 EOD. Blocker details: need 3 extra test DB instances for replay (small size). Can @eng-infra help with quota?

Maya Patel: Confirmed tentative dates (canary start Tue 4/12, finalize Thu 4/14). Blocker: need rollback script reviewed — I'll post PR today. @Patrick Li please ack when you see the PR.

Patrick Li: Ack — will review PR when posted. Tentative QA window Mon 4/11 10–12am PT. If that works, I can prioritize.

Emily Ryu: Confirmed Fri 4/15 for runbook. No blockers besides time to review with SRE — can someone schedule 30m review with eng-sre?

Alex Chen: I'll schedule the 30m review with eng-sre and loop PMs. I'll also file an infra ticket for Julian's test instances now.

IncidentBot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 48 hours for thread 2390123456.

Alex Chen: Awesome — Ill compile these into the postmortem checklist and update the action tracker. If anyone needs to change dates, update here so I don't incorrectly close items. :spiral_note_pad:
